images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Caption identifies a colourised SEM of yellow Marburg virions budding from and attached to an infected blue VERO E6 cell. Strong contrast and numerous filaments suit a near-square crop.

images.author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, Fort Detrick, Maryland
images.why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of orange Marburg virus particles harvested from infected VERO E6 cell supernatant. Vivid orange against teal clearly reveals filamentous morphology.

images.author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, Fort Detrick, Maryland
images.why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of two gold Marburg virus particles harvested from infected VERO E6 cell supernatant. Distinct filaments against pink-purple provide a clear focal subject; preserve both during cropping.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies an SEM of yellow Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever virus particles budding from cultured patient epithelial cells. Purple cellular structures provide strong contrast and flexible cropping.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Scientific caption confirms an SEM of yellow CCHF virions budding from cultured patient epithelial cells, despite the misleading automatic page title. Blue cellular background offers an alternative colour palette.

images.author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, Fort Detrick, Maryland
images.why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of mature extracellular Nipah particles in red beside an infected blue VERO cell. Multiple clearly separated virions and strong colour contrast suit a full-bleed card.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of one central red Nipah virion that has budded from an infected blue cell. Yellow immunogold particles label viral surface glycoproteins; the central subject suits near-square framing.
